actions.action: Inspect plants to distinguish pest type (fluttering, shape, webbing, jumping)
Tap a leaf over white paper to check for spider mites
Spray plants with a strong jet of water, especially leaf undersides, every few days
Test insecticidal soap on one leaf, then apply every 5-7 days for about 3 weeks
Rinse herbs before eating after soap treatment
Place yellow sticky traps near plants
Check rest of collection on leaf undersides and stems
Keep plants quarantined for 3-4 weeks after last sign of pests
Post closer photos of leaf undersides or moving specks

reason: Aphids are named only as one of several possibilities, but the first treatment step—a hard rinse with water repeated every few days—matches the fix that worked, and nothing suggested is harmful.
